 CAT 2026 Admit Card: Hall ticket to be released on November 4 at iimcat.ac.in, check download steps
 IIM Indore will release the CAT 2026 admit card on November 4. Registered candidates can download it online before the November 29 exam and check their allotted test slot.
 Curated by Yash Wardhan Singh 
 Image: Official website 
 Oct 27, 2026
 Share
 The Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Indore will make the CAT 2026 admit card available on November 4. Candidates who have registered for the exam can download it from the official website, iimcat.ac.in. 
 The Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026 will take place on November 29. To access the hall ticket, candidates must log in to the website using their registered user ID and password. 
 After downloading the admit card, candidates should check their exam centre, test slot, reporting time and other important instructions. They should also print a copy of the hall ticket and keep it ready for exam day. 
 CAT 2026 exam timings 
 The examination will be held in three sessions on November 29. The schedule is given below: 
 Slot 1: 8:30 am to 10:30 am 
 Slot 2: 12:30 pm to 2:30 pm 
 Slot 3: 4:30 pm to 6:30 pm 
 Candidates must check their assigned slot and reporting time on the admit card. They should follow all the instructions given in the document. 
 How to download CAT 2026 admit card 
 Candidates can download their hall tickets after the link becomes active on the official website. They need to follow these steps: 
 1. Open the official website at iimcat.ac.in. 
 2. Click on the registered candidate login option. 
 3. Enter your user ID and password. 
 4. Find the CAT 2026 admit card link on the dashboard. 
 5. Download the hall ticket and save it as a PDF. 
 6. Check all the information mentioned on it. 
 7. Print a copy as required by the examination authorities. 
 Candidates should keep their login details ready to make the download process easier. 
 Details to check on the CAT 2026 admit card 
 After downloading the hall ticket, candidates should carefully check the following information: 
 Name and registration number 
 Photograph and signature 
 Exam date and allotted slot 
 Reporting time 
 Address of the examination centre 
 Instructions for exam day 
 If any information is incorrect, candidates should contact the examination authorities for help. 
 IIM Indore will conduct CAT 2026 for admission to management courses at the Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs) and other participating institutes. 
 Candidates who have completed registration can download their admit cards from the official website. They should regularly check the portal for updates and read the exam instructions carefully before appearing for the test.
